reason: The speed numbers are exactly what I care about, so I'd install it and run my own RAW+JPG folder through it. But I'd keep FastStone as default because it's a 0.4.1 from one guy and nothing says it handles culling and printing as well as what I already use.
why_switch_or_not: Rapid next x5 at 85 ms against 600-900 ms for FastStone is something I would feel on a big shoot, and RAW and JPG always showing as separate pictures is how I want to cull. But the page never mentions printing, ratings/tags or side-by-side compare, and my relatives' phone photos are often HEIC, which needs a Microsoft extension. I'd only move my default after weeks of it not crashing or choking on my files.
current_app_pros: FastStone's full-screen mode, the thumbnail browser and the simple editor are all things I use daily, and my muscle memory is set. It opens everything I throw at it and I know where the print and resize options are.
current_app_pains: Rapid next through a pile of RAWs lags noticeably, 600-900 ms for five steps is the kind of delay I notice. Otherwise it is fine, nothing else really bugs me.
objection: One developer, version 0.4.1: I don't know if it will be maintained, or if it will do the boring things I need (print a photo my relative sent) as reliably as FastStone does.
would_change_my_mind: Showing that it prints a picture from the viewer with proper sizing, and that my own RAW+JPG culling folder runs through full-screen with no crashes for a week.
